topology_reasoning: This is a 1×4 multimode interference (MMI) power splitter. Light enters from the single input taper at the bottom, expands into the wide MMI body where multimode interference creates 4 self-images at the top edge, which are then collected by 4 output tapers. Function-defining knobs: (1) MMI body width and length determine the imaging condition; (2) taper lengths and tip widths control mode matching and insertion loss; (3) output taper spacing determines port separation; (4) gap between output tapers affects crosstalk.
